steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved drafts.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the draft scenario.
Apply the setting whose effect on the draft's Items control is under test.
Apply the additional configuration specified by the case.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab containing the saved eRFX draft.
Open the first saved draft, which reopens its create screen.
Assert that the Items 1 control is not offered in the saved draft.
